thread:
ophelia: Heads-up — starting canary for v2 proxy but seeing a spike in 429s on long-stream endpoints. Can we pause cutover until we triage?

deploybot: Canary progress: 3/5 healthy. Alert: streaming endpoints 429 rate +8% over baseline in last 5m. Auto-threshold approaching rollback criteria.

liam: Which tenants are affected? any common request headers or client SDK versions?

ophelia: acme-inc and beta-warehouse are the big ones. Logs show repeated `ERR_STREAM_CHUNK` and a few `unexpected EOF` during init. Looks like header-case and chunking handshake differences.

asha: :eyes: i'd pin those tenants to v1 while we investigate. low blast radius and fast to revert.

chris: Agreed. Pinning is lowest-friction. Liam—can you run the pin command and confirm?

liam: Running the pin now:```/deploybot pin tenant=acme-inc v=1 reason="stream-429" operator=liam``` and```/deploybot pin tenant=beta-warehouse v=1 reason="stream-429" operator=liam```

deploybot: ACK: pinned acme-inc -> v1 by liam at 1725000100.
deploybot: ACK: pinned beta-warehouse -> v1 by liam at 1725000120.

ophelia: Thanks — i'll start a bisect on the proxy deserialization changes (PRs merged last 48h). ETA ~25m, will post trace snippets.

vikram: Can we also throw a short header-normalization shim in the gateway? Might be faster than a full revert if it's just case / charset mismatch.

sara: Also please add a short blurb to the release notes: "temporary pinning applied to tenants with streaming clients; fix in progress" plus rollback criteria.

chris: For clarity — our rollback/halt criteria should be: global streaming 429s >5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increases >200ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows. If hit, full stop and roll back to previous canary image. Is everyone aligned?

ophelia: aligned. i'll add that to the ops checklist and update the release notes.

deploybot: Canary paused by operator request (ophelia). Current status: PAUSED. Remediation ticket created: INF-3412.

asha: After the patch, recommend a soft canary: run on non-streaming tenants only for 15m, then expand to mixed traffic for another 15m before full resume.

liam: I'll own the hotfix rollback runbook and coordinate with infra to confirm no config drift during re-deploy.

ophelia: thanks everyone — i'll post bisect logs and a short summary in 30m :thumbsup:

chris: good plan. keep ops-eyes on the dashboards.

vikram: If shim looks trivial i can ship a quick gateway rule now, otherwise wait for the proxy patch.

ophelia: I'll grab logs and call out the exact header mismatch. Cheers.
